name: Yuri Daisuke
source:
Kuze's maternal cousin. He is from a prominent family and his father is the Minister of Health, Labor and Welfare, but his bad behavior makes his family and Kuze worry about him. Although he doesn't attend university very often, he makes good use of his time and avoids repeating years. He often makes fun of Kuze, but...
